dbOutcome.summary: The agent matched 69562 (exact_cask, web evidence supportive, no risks), but the server's cask-code check downgraded it to no_match because the source cask '26129' lacked the stored 'SR' prefix.

provenance.notes: Saved check 34813, source auction_lot 14670 (lot 185-904996), run 2026-11-03. This is a post-filter case: the classifier's decision was right and the code downgrade made it wrong. It passes once PR #1587 lands. The lot page gives distilled 29.04.2013, cask 26129, first-fill bourbon hogshead, one of 219 bottles, 55.4%. The lot photo's label prints 'Specially bottled for Dornoch Castle', 'Thompson Bros.', 'Vintage 2013', 'Aged 13 years in a 1st fill Bourbon hogshead', 'Cask no. SR26129', 'one of 219 Bottles', 55.4%. 69562 stores caskNumber SR26129, vintage 2013, age 13, 55.4%, Brand Thompson Bros., distiller Clynelish. The scraper's '26129' is the same cask with the prefix dropped.

expected.summary: Match Thompson Bros. Clynelish 2013 13-year-old, cask SR26129 (69562). The lot lists cask 26129; the label prints SR26129, and the vintage, age, 55.4% and 219-bottle outturn all agree.

knownFailure.reason: The server cask-code check downgrades a right match when the source leaves out the SR prefix.
